scope: QA152-QA155 resident board and idle pages
method: Actual page JavaScript in isolated Node VMs with two synthetic residents and intercepted APIs, uploads, modals and navigation

findings.observed: After resident B's detail read was denied, resident A's post and one old comment remained visible. The old comment action issued one request under B; an old close confirmation issued one request after switching to B.
After B's reads were denied, A's item and list remained visible. The old contact action issued one request and called a synthetic phone callback under B; an old list card still navigated.
After switching A to B, A's draft stayed visible. B's image action used idle/A and B's create request retained A's community ID.
After switching A to B, A's draft stayed visible. B's image action used board/A and B's create request retained A's community ID.

realCalls: No real phone call, upload, post, item, payment or transaction
limits: Service-side authorization may reject the stale requests; online incidence is unknown
status: Reproduced in isolation; remediation awaits user decisions
